Class SimulationRecorder

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.SimulationRecorder
public class SimulationRecorder extends Object
Records a simulation written in Java (e.g., a Bio7 model) step by step and exports it to an HTML page which plays the recording: Play/Pause, Step, Reset, the speed, a timeline to jump to a step, a loop and the chart (see HtmlSimulation for the views). The model runs in Java (any model, the exact results), the page only plays the recorded frames (the settings of the model cannot be changed in the page).

Each step adds a frame with the data of the view: a grid of cells (GRID_2D, with optional agents), points and lines (SCENE_3D) or a surface (SURFACE_3D) and the values of the chart. 

SimulationRecorder recorder = new SimulationRecorder("Game of Life").view(HtmlSimulation.View.GRID_2D)
                .palette(0xFFFFFF, 0x1F3A93).chart("Population");
for (int t = 0; t < 300; t++) {
        step(); // the model
        recorder.frame().grid(width, height, cells).chart("Population", alive);
}
recorder.export("/path/life.html");
In a Bio7 model the frame can be recorded in the run method (e.g., if SpatialUtil.canStep() is true) and exported after a number of frames.
